sourceScope: #85/#548 support interlocking programs and keeping fundamentals. #123 discusses shorter submaximal familiar work while combining with conventional lifting; it does not give a universal get-up maintenance dose or recurrence interval. Actual host-space accounting and admitted-learner continuity are Strength Lab adaptations. Existing movement doses, progression and return rules remain authoritative.
behavior: Focused maintenance capacity and due selection use only the protected core and admitted learner, curated exactly like actual written workouts. Queued programs do not provide imaginary host space.

Admission accounts for a dedicated program visit when an earned target cannot fit those hosts; one hostable component does not certify a whole maintenance program. Existing no-target fallback reservation remains conservative.

A genuinely begun hinted learner retains its place if its program-day opportunity remains available. Due maintenance can still take its own turn; this is continuation, not new admission or guaranteed simultaneous coverage.
An untouched planned hint cannot bypass admission. Current equipment, prerequisites, recovery, actual unfinished work, core reservations, time and movement ceilings retain priority.
At 30 minutes the due 13-day-old get-up receives actual earned maintenance rather than waiting for an unscheduled hinge program. At 45/60 minutes it can join the actual ground workout.

Completed light maintenance does not earn advancement or load review. Correcting it away restores the due target; undo and backups replay actuals. No setting, root storage format, target dose or method identity is changed.

results.reproduceTargeted: node scripts/compare-maintenance-hosts.cjs /tmp/baseline-engine.js (export baseCommit engine.js with git show first)
results.ordinaryComparison: All three forty-week cases retain counts, qualification dates and final progression. Two-year 45/60 cases also retain those outcomes. At 30 minutes the two-year case records one fewer earned return, one fewer progressing-work receipt and one additional maintenance receipt, with the same qualification dates and final state.
results.targetedSummary: In 119 actual workouts following the checkpoint, 30-minute first get-up exposure moves from gap 27/reentry to gap 13/earned light maintenance. Get-up returns fall four to two; core workouts remain 107 and all five programs stay selected. No ground/hinge foundation cycles qualify in that genuinely crowded case. 45/60-minute targeted histories are unchanged.

limitations: All ten gate areas remain unresolved. This prevents fictitious packing and learner churn; it does not make genuinely oversized selections feasible.
The fixture is explicitly selected/imported prior work, not claimed to have been automatically generated within a thirty-minute schedule.

Capacity remains an estimate. A begun lane may coexist with temporarily insufficient estimated maintenance space; due maintenance and core priority remain in force, and the engine does not promise every movement the same frequency.
The archive inventory, 54 movement routes, 38 reviewed outlines and 16 instructional/verification gaps are unchanged. Physical Android and technique acceptance remain separate.

The first stricter admission prototype repeatedly ejected the begun row learner and lost qualification; it was discarded. Actual begun-lane continuity is regression-tested without admitting an untouched hint.
